SUMMARY.md:
> Every response carries the agency, dataset, licence and effective date of the figures it contains. Values are reproduced from official federal releases and are never modelled or estimated; a null is a value the agency did not publish and never means zero.
>
> No key and no rate limit. `robots.txt` disallows `/api/` for crawl budget, not permission, an on-demand request for one named record is expected and welcome; walking every slug is not. CSV twins of each export (/api/export/hospital/{slug}.csv, /api/export/agency/{slug}.csv, /api/export/school/{slug}.csv, /api/export/district/{slug}.csv) were removed on 2026-10-23: one entity cannot load from both a JSON and a CSV route.
How many records the rank is out of
Rank within this entity type only, respecting the direction of the measure, so a low value wins where low is better. Never comparable across entity types.
null means the agency published no value for this record. It never means zero, and the two must not be conflated downstream.
